title: Flame Enamelled Armour

sources.title: Seldom Caught Unawares (+2)
markers: | description = You gain a +2 bonus to {{Initiative|Initiative rolls}}.

sources.title: Fire Shield: Warm
markers: | description = Scorching flames shed light in a {{dist|m=3}} radius. You take only [[Resistance|half the damage]] of all {{DamageType|Cold}} damage, and deal {{DamageText|2d8|Fire}} damage to anyone who hits you with a melee attack.

sources.title: Fire Shield
markers: | description = Wreathe your body in flames that shed light in a {{dist|m=3}} radius, provide [[Resistance]] to {{DamageType|Fire}} or {{DamageType|Cold}} damage, and retaliate against melee attacks.

summary: Medium Armour with base AC 16 plus up to +2 from Dexterity, +2 Initiative, Fire resistance, +2 saving throws, and Fire Shield: Warm.

fields.Fire Shield: Warm: Action on yourself once per Long Rest. For 10 turns gain Cold resistance and retaliate against melee hits for 2d8 Fire, or 4d8 if the attacker scores a critical hit. The shared source reports no gameplay light effect.
fields.Base value: 2900 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Endurance by Fire: Fire resistance and +2 to all saving throws.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
